el.Propuestas pensadas para integrarse a re: Offerings designed to fit into retreats, gatherings, trips and wellness experiences, adapted to the theme, the schedule and the needs of each group.
el.Qué aporto a tu retiro: What I bring to your retreat
el.Una práctica que sostiene el clima del e: A practice that supports the atmosphere of the gathering instead of competing with it.
el.Trabajo con una mirada integral del Yoga: I work with a holistic view of Yoga: body, breath and meditation in a single experience. This allows me to tailor each session to the moment of the retreat — an active practice that wakes the group up in the morning, or an introspective, restorative experience to close the day.
el.La intención es que cada participante no: My intention is that participants don't just have a lovely time during the retreat, but also take home concrete tools to bring into their everyday lives.
Three experiences, which can be combined.
el.Cada una funciona sola o como parte de u: Each one works on its own or as part of a longer program.
el.Hatha Yoga · Cuerpo, respiración y medit: Hatha Yoga · Body, breath and meditation
el.Una práctica integral que combina asanas: A complete practice that combines asanas, mindful breathing, Pranayamas, relaxation and meditation.
el.La clase se adapta al momento del retiro: The class adapts to the moment of the retreat and to the group: it can be a more active, energizing practice, or a more introspective and restorative experience.
el.Taller de respiración consciente, Pranay: Conscious breathing, Pranayama and mantra workshop
el.Una experiencia teórico-práctica para ex: A theoretical and practical experience to explore the breath as a bridge between the body, the mind and our inner world.
el.Práctica y explicación de diferentes Pra: Practice and explanation of different Pranayamas.
el.Cada participante se lleva herramientas: Each participant takes home concrete tools to bring into their everyday life.
el.Una experiencia que integra respiración: An experience that brings together conscious breathing, free movement, music and dance.
el.Una invitación a salir de las formas est: An invitation to step out of set forms, connect with the body through enjoyment and let the breath turn into movement. Playful and deep at once: inhabit your body, release tension and connect with your own energy.
el.Ajusto contenidos, tono y bibliografía a: I adjust content, tone and reading list to the common thread of the gathering you're putting together.
el.Al espacio y al grupo: To the space and the group
el.Al lugar, a la cantidad de participantes: To the venue, the number of participants and the particular characteristics of the group.
el.Días y horarios se definen según la gril: Days and times are set according to the retreat's program. The offerings can be combined.
el.Valores en dólares, por propuesta. Escri: Prices in US dollars, per offering. Write to me with the dates and location and we'll put together something tailor-made.
el.Hace más de diez años acompaño a alumnas: For more than ten years I have been supporting Yoga students and teachers in deepening their practice.
el.Todas las propuestas de Piku Yoga parten: All of Piku Yoga's offerings start from a holistic view of Yoga, understanding the practice as a path that runs through body, mind and spirit. Besides retreats, I lead the Yoga Postgraduate, an ongoing study group, and one-on-one mentoring for teachers and holistic projects.
el.Contame la temática, el lugar y las fech: Tell me the theme, the place and the dates, and I'll prepare a proposal tailored to your group.

at.Piku guiando una práctica con los brazos: Piku guiding a practice with open arms
at.Movimiento libre y danza en la shala: Free movement and dance in the shala
